name: Showcase
changes: A long form in a bottom sheet on Dialogs & drawers
description: Every component a space can draw and every phone feature it can ask for, on real data.
schema: CREATE TABLE tasks (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))), title TEXT NOT NULL, done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Normal', due TEXT, created TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
CREATE TABLE sales (month TEXT NOT NULL, product TEXT NOT NULL, units INTEGER NOT NULL, revenue REAL NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, text TEXT NOT NULL, me INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
CREATE TABLE photos (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, src TEXT NOT NULL, alt TEXT)
CREATE TABLE files (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, type TEXT, size INTEGER, uri TEXT NOT NULL, at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
CREATE TABLE signups (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT, bio TEXT, plan TEXT, at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

card.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE done = 0) AS open, (SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE done = 1) AS done, (SELECT printf('€%,d', sum(revenue)) FROM sales WHERE month = (SELECT max(month) FROM sales)) AS revenue
card.chart: SELECT sum(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

widget.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE done = 0) AS open, (SELECT count(*) FROM tasks) AS total, round(1.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE done = 1) / max((SELECT count(*) FROM tasks), 1), 2) AS ratio, (SELECT printf('€%,d', sum(revenue)) FROM sales WHERE month = (SELECT max(month) FROM sales)) AS revenue, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now', '+25 minutes') AS focus

children.query: SELECT substr(month, 6, 2) AS label, sum(revenue) AS value FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

children.text: a widget the space drew itself

large.query: SELECT substr(month, 6, 2) AS label, sum(revenue) AS value, product AS series FROM sales GROUP BY month, product ORDER BY month
